gazetteer_names_needed.name: Sierra Maestra
gazetteer_names_needed.hint: mountain range in Granma and Santiago de Cuba provinces, Cuba, about 77.0-76.0 W, 19.9-20.2 N; the Cliopatria 'Cuban Communists' 1958 shape stands in for it

gaps.what: No dossier written: its three shapes (1932, 1936, 1945) are reviewed in the existing brazilian-republic dossier, which holds all four Q155 Names and says the other slugs should not get dossiers
Coto War 1921 and the White Award, and the Panama-Colombia and Panama-Costa Rica frontier treaties, not opened (Cliopatria's Panama shape does not change then; republic-of-costa-rica carries 1921)

Where the Maderistas held ground in 1910-1911: neither page names land; Cliopatria's 114-cell Chihuahua zone stands unverified and the sieged Ciudad Juarez lies outside it; the 1910 months before the shape are not drawn
1936 shape change (three cells out to Paraguay, three cells in from Cliopatria's Bolivia shape, about 760 km2 each way): no page dates or names it; two confidence-1 events
The 1936 border treaty (and the 1935 and 1929 treaties) name no land and no winner; no Cliopatria cell moves, so no gain or loss recorded
Extent of the rebel-held Sierra Maestra and its start before 1958 (Granma landing 2 December 1956): the page gives no area or dates; Cliopatria's 3,144 km2 zone stands unverified

problems: unitary-state-of-brazil has no dossier by design: brazilian-republic (another am-08 part) already merges the four Q155 rows (Brazilian Republic, Unitary State of Brazil, Federated Republic of Brazil, Republic of Brazil) and reviews unitary-state-of-brazil_1932/_1936/_1945; it validates. The orchestrator should not count the slug as missing.

One state, several rows (colour agent: one hue each): argentine-confederation + argentine-republic (found 1930 is a row boundary, confidence 1); haiti + empire-of-haiti + republic-of-haiti (found 1936 is a row boundary, confidence 1).

cuban-communists: Cliopatria's label 'Cuban Communists' is Castro's 26th of July Movement zone in the Sierra Maestra; display name changed accordingly (Cliopatria name kept in cliopatria_names and alt_names). On the pages the zone is rebel for 1958 only (Batista fled 1 January 1959) whereas Cliopatria keeps it apart through 1959 and gives it to communist-cuba in 1960; republic-of-cuba already records a 1 January 1959 gain, communist-cuba should agree.

Matching events wanted from other dossiers: british-colonial-empire (eu-11) for Argentina's occupation of the Falklands and South Georgia, 2 April to 14 June 1982; bolivia for the three cells Argentina gains in 1936; united-states-of-america already has the Canal Zone gain (1904) and loss (1979) matching republic-of-panama.

republic-of-panama: Cliopatria returns the Canal Zone to Panama in 2000 (5 cells); the pages say the Zone ceased to exist on 1 October 1979, so the dossier adjusts the 1905 shape to 1904-1978 and adds a 1979-1999 keyframe on the 2000 outline.
Rebel dossiers with months inside one year (maderistas, cuban-communists contest events): a yearly compiler should not hide the rebel colour for the whole year.
